name: NewGem Foods

about:
NewGem Foods operates from Allyn, Washington, where it produces a line of plant-based wraps. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but it describes itself as the original creator of 100% plant-based wraps designed to replace bread, tortillas, and seaweed in sushi.

The product range includes sandwich wraps and sushi wraps made from vegetables and fruits such as tomato, carrot, mango, kale, and apple. Each wrap is formulated to be gluten-free, low in calories (25–45 per wrap), and to deliver a full serving of fruit or vegetables. The wraps are produced using non-GMO, identity-preserved soybeans and carry a patented formulation. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

The wraps are sold direct to consumers through the company’s Shopify store and through retail partners including Whole Foods and Wegmans, as well as to restaurants that have featured them for years. The company markets to home cooks, sushi enthusiasts, and health-conscious shoppers looking for bread alternatives.

NewGem Foods positions its wraps as a way to reduce food waste, noting that bread and tortillas are among the largest contributors to global food waste. The patented, colorful wraps are intended to add flavor and nutrition while eliminating the need for traditional grain-based carriers.
